name: 02_vague_user_no_extraction
description: Vague user. Replies that carry no extractable facts ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'depends on') leave ProjectState untouched while the deterministic extractor records unknown_facts. The objective stays on PERSONAS and the question-family history advances through all three personas families.

turns.user: I don't know yet, let me think
turns.expect_reply: That's a meaningful starting point. To focus the design on the right people, who specifically would benefit from this - can you describe the people you're designing for?
expect_unknown_facts: I don't know yet, let me think

turns.expect_reply: Good - I can see the audience taking shape. To make the picture concrete, can you think of one specific person who would use this - what are they like?
expect_unknown_facts: I don't know yet, let me think

turns.expect_reply: That's a solid start on who they are. To sharpen the persona, what is the age, role, or background of the people you're designing for?
expect_unknown_facts: I don't know yet, let me think
